intro.text: A spot in the Elendel Basin where the railway from Doxonar to Elendel runs especially near the canal.

items.text: Having lost many men in their clash at the Yomen-Ostlin wedding dinner, the gang wanted one last aluminum theft to restock while they hid. Waxillium Ladrian rightly guessed they would strike House Tekiel's Breaknaught as it went past here.
